caveats: All additions/reference alternatives are analyst-authored executable Dafny drafts, not model-generated repositories or mathematical proof evidence.
The DynamicArray Valid? body and backing data field remain hidden; the extension uses the documented exported contracts rather than revealing representation details.
This is append-oriented library extension under supplied contracts, not discovery of a reusable abstraction or a necessary two-file edit task.
Both zero-length input and pivots at either endpoint are legitimate cases; no unnecessary nonempty precondition is imposed.
Verification assumes Dafny execution semantics and does not prove host memory availability, amortized complexity or runtime performance.
Per-case copies preserve exact upstream source bytes; explicit command_files define checked scope, staging alone is not coverage.
No held-out, causal sharing/depth, or language-performance claim is justified by this one selected component.

baseline_required_review: Native CSV/stdout/stderr and exact source/command/tool/resource bindings
Complete original named-unit inventory; assess constructors, reads/validity obligations, all actual provider obligations
Named AppendAll/AppendRotated outcomes plus all emitted new units
Exact inherited warnings; new warning/frontend/resource/timeout categories separate
Wrong cases must fail named proof targets, not parse; omitted cases must native-pass but lack required target
Unproved-parent case requires AppendAll failure and AppendRotated pass under its assumed contract, still reject workspace
coverage_policy.fixed_total_declarations_if_unlogged: Record explicit source-bound inventory exceptions after baseline review; never call them logged passes

parent_policy.stage_two_parent: Future actual accepted stage-one source and native receipt from the same lineage; never substitute analyst references

project_scope: Dependency-closed DynamicArray component, not all Dafny standard libraries

stages.alternative: Recursive Push of head followed by AppendAll of tail
stages.frame: reads a,a.Repr; modifies pre-state a.Repr, plus freshly allocated objects by Dafny semantics
stages.input: A valid existing DynamicArray and an executable input sequence
stages.new_behavior: Append every input value in its original order while preserving all prior elements
stages.reference: Iterative Push with exact sequence-prefix, size, validity, capacity, freshness and decreasing-index invariants

stages.alternative: Direct Push loop over the rotated batch, with no AppendAll call; admissible, separately observed reuse=0
stages.input: A valid DynamicArray, an executable sequence, and pivot in0..length
stages.new_behavior: Append a cyclic left rotation of the batch and return its exact physical index interval
stages.reference: Use actual accepted AppendAll on suffix then prefix; thread its updated representation and fresh allocation facts across two calls

toolchain.tool_binary_and_solver_identity: Root qualified toolchain must be checked on compute; not observed by this construction
